    55→    def init_project(self, repo_url: str) -> str:
    56→        """Initialize a project from a repo URL.
    57→
    58→        - If .git/ already exists, raise error (one-off operation).
    59→        - If remote has content (brownfield): clone into project_dir.
    60→        - If remote is empty (greenfield): git init, scaffold, commit, push.
    61→
    62→        Returns:
    63→            "brownfield" or "greenfield" indicating the init mode.
    64→        """
    65→        if (self.project_dir / ".git").exists():
    66→            raise GitManagerError(

    68→            )
    69→
    70→        self.project_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    71→

    74→        # Check if remote exists and has content

    82→        # Persist project config

    85→        logger.info("Project initialized: mode=%s, dir=%s", mode, self.project_dir)

    88→    def _remote_has_content(self, auth_url: str) -> bool:

    98→            if "authentication" in stderr.lower() or "403" in stderr or "401" in stderr:

   100→            raise GitManagerError(f"Cannot reach remote repository: {stderr}")

   103→    def _init_brownfield(self, auth_url: str) -> str:
   104→        """Clone an existing repo into project_dir."""

   110→    def _init_greenfield(self, auth_url: str, repo_url: str) -> str:

   197→        )
   198→        sha = result.stdout.strip()
   199→        logger.info("Committed: %s (%s)", message, sha[:8])
   200→        return sha
   201→
   202→    def push_branch(self, branch: str):
   203→        """Push branch to origin."""
   204→        self._run_git(
   205→            ["git", "push", "origin", branch], check=True
   206→        )
   207→        logger.info("Pushed branch: %s", branch)
   208→
   209→    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
   210→    # Pull Request Creation
   211→    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
   212→
   213→    def create_pull_request(
   214→        self, title: str, branch: str, body: str
   215→    ) -> str:
   216→        """Create a PR via GitHub or Bitbucket REST API. Returns PR URL."""
   217→        if self.provider == "github":
   218→            return self._create_github_pr(title, branch, body)
   219→        elif self.provider == "bitbucket":
   220→            return self._create_bitbucket_pr(title, branch, body)
   221→        else:
   222→            raise GitManagerError(f"Unsupported provider: {self.provider}")
   223→
   224→    def _create_github_pr(self, title: str, branch: str, body: str) -> str:
   225→        """Create PR via GitHub REST API."""
   226→        config = self.load_config()
   227→        owner, repo = self._parse_owner_repo(config["repo_url"])
   228→
   229→        url = f"https://api.github.com/repos/{owner}/{repo}/pulls"
   230→        headers = {
   231→            "Authorization": f"Bearer {self.github_token}",
   232→            "Accept": "application/vnd.github+json",
   233→        }
   234→        payload = {
   235→            "title": title,
   236→            "head": branch,
   237→            "base": self.default_branch,
   238→            "body": body,
   239→        }
   240→
   241→        with httpx.Client(timeout=30.0) as client:
   242→            resp = client.post(url, json=payload, headers=headers)
   243→            resp.raise_for_status()
   244→            pr_url = resp.json()["html_url"]
   245→
   246→        logger.info("GitHub PR created: %s", pr_url)
   247→        return pr_url
   248→
   249→    def _create_bitbucket_pr(self, title: str, branch: str, body: str) -> str:
   250→        """Create PR via Bitbucket REST API."""
   251→        config = self.load_config()
   252→        workspace, repo = self._parse_owner_repo(config["repo_url"])
   253→
   254→        url = f"https://api.bitbucket.org/2.0/repositories/{workspace}/{repo}/pullrequests"
   255→        auth = (self.bitbucket_username, self.bitbucket_app_password)
   256→        payload = {
   257→            "title": title,
   258→            "source": {"branch": {"name": branch}},
   259→            "destination": {"branch": {"name": self.default_branch}},
   260→            "description": body,
   261→        }
   262→
   263→        with httpx.Client(timeout=30.0) as client:
   264→            resp = client.post(url, json=payload, auth=auth)
   265→            resp.raise_for_status()
   266→            pr_url = resp.json()["links"]["html"]["href"]
   267→
   268→        logger.info("Bitbucket PR created: %s", pr_url)
   269→        return pr_url
   270→
   271→    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
   272→    # Internal Helpers
   273→    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
   274→
   275→    def _build_authenticated_url(self, repo_url: str) -> str:
   276→        """Build an authenticated git URL from a plain repo URL."""
   277→        parsed = urlparse(repo_url)
   278→        host = parsed.hostname or ""
   279→        path = parsed.path
   280→
   281→        # Strip .git suffix for consistency, re-add later
   282→        if path.endswith(".git"):
   283→            path = path[:-4]
   284→
   285→        if self.provider == "github" and self.github_token:
   286→            return f"https://{self.github_token}@{host}{path}.git"
   287→        elif self.provider == "bitbucket" and self.bitbucket_username and self.bitbucket_app_password:
   288→            return f"https://{self.bitbucket_username}:{self.bitbucket_app_password}@{host}{path}.git"
   289→        else:
   290→            # Fall back to original URL (may work for public repos)
   291→            return repo_url
   292→
   293→    def _parse_owner_repo(self, repo_url: str) -> tuple:
   294→        """Extract (owner, repo) from a repo URL."""
   295→        parsed = urlparse(repo_url)
   296→        path = parsed.path.strip("/")
   297→        if path.endswith(".git"):
   298→            path = path[:-4]
   299→        parts = path.split("/")
   300→        if len(parts) < 2:
   301→            raise GitManagerError(f"Cannot parse owner/repo from URL: {repo_url}")
   302→        return parts[-2], parts[-1]
   303→
   304→    def _save_config(self, repo_url: str):
   305→        """Persist project config to .haikai/config.json."""
   306→        config_dir = self.project_dir / ".haikai"
   307→        config_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
   308→        config = {
   309→            "repo_url": repo_url,
   310→            "provider": self.provider,
   311→            "default_branch": self.default_branch,
   312→            "initialized_at": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
   313→        }
   314→        (config_dir / "config.json").write_text(
   315→            json.dumps(config, indent=2), encoding="utf-8"
   316→        )
   317→        logger.info("Saved project config: %s", config_dir / "config.json")
   318→
   319→    def _run_git(self, cmd: list, check: bool = True) -> subprocess.CompletedProcess:
   320→        """Run a git command in the project directory."""
   321→        logger.debug("git cmd: %s", " ".join(cmd))
   322→        result = subprocess.run(
   323→            cmd,
   324→            cwd=self.project_dir,
   325→            capture_output=True,
   326→            text=True,
   327→            timeout=120,
   328→        )
   329→        if check and result.returncode != 0:
   330→            error_msg = result.stderr.strip() or result.stdout.strip()
   331→            raise GitManagerError(
   332→                f"Git command failed: {' '.join(cmd)}\n{error_msg}"
   333→            )
   334→        return result
   335→

    13→class ShapeSpecRequest(BaseModel):

1→"""
     2→Agent-OS Orchestrator for automated workflow execution.
     3→
     4→This module provides the main orchestration logic for running Agent-OS workflows
     5→(write-spec, create-tasks, implement-tasks) without user interaction.
     6→"""
     7→
     8→import logging
     9→import json
    10→from pathlib import Path
    11→from datetime import datetime
    12→from typing import List, Dict, Any
    13→
    14→from .agent_os_models import (
    15→    OrchestrationRequest,
    16→    OrchestrationResponse,
    17→    OrchestrationV2Response,
    18→    StepResult,
    19→    ImplementationPackage,
    20→    ImplementationPackageFile,
    21→)
    22→from .chat.claude_chat_executor import ClaudeChatExecutor
    23→
    24→logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
    25→
    26→
    27→class AgentOSOrchestrator:
    28→    """
    29→    Orchestrates the execution of Agent-OS workflows.
    30→
    31→    This class manages the end-to-end workflow of:
    32→    0. Validating that spec folder and requirements.md exist (fails if missing)
    33→    1. Running /write-spec to create spec.md
    34→    2. Running /create-tasks to create tasks.md
    35→    3. Running /implement-tasks to implement all tasks
    36→
    37→    Spec folders and requirements.md MUST be created by /shape-spec before orchestration.
    38→    The orchestrator never creates folders or stub files — it only processes pre-shaped specs.
    39→    """
    40→    
    41→    # Command definitions
    42→    COMMANDS = [
    43→        {"step": 1, "command": "/write-spec", "description": "Write specification"},
    44→        {"step": 2, "command": "/create-tasks", "description": "Create task list"},
    45→        {"step": 3, "command": "/implement-tasks", "description": "Implement all tasks"}
    46→    ]
    47→    
    48→    def __init__(
    49→        self,
    50→        request: OrchestrationRequest,
    51→        anthropic_api_key: str,
    52→        workspace_dir: str,
    53→        logs_dir: str,
    54→        session_id: str = None,
    55→    ):
    56→        """
    57→        Initialize the orchestrator.
    58→
    59→        Args:
    60→            request: The orchestration request containing spec intents and options
    61→            anthropic_api_key: Anthropic API key for Claude CLI
    62→            workspace_dir: Base workspace directory path
    63→            logs_dir: Directory for storing orchestration logs
    64→            session_id: Active session UUID (from session_store)
    65→        """
    66→        self.request = request
    67→        self.anthropic_api_key = anthropic_api_key
    68→        self.session_id = session_id
    69→        self.workspace_dir = Path(workspace_dir)
    70→        self.logs_dir = Path(logs_dir)
    71→        self.logs_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    72→        
    73→        # Construct project directory from company/project and validate
    74→        self.project_dir = self.workspace_dir / request.company / request.project
    75→
    76→        if not self.workspace_dir.exists():
    77→            raise ValueError(
    78→                f"Workspace directory does not exist: {self.workspace_dir}"
    79→            )
    80→
    81→        company_dir = self.workspace_dir / request.company
    82→        if not company_dir.exists():
    83→            raise ValueError(
    84→                f"Company '{request.company}' not found in workspace. "
    85→                f"Directory does not exist: {company_dir}"
    86→            )
    87→
    88→        if not self.project_dir.exists():
    89→            raise ValueError(
    90→                f"Project '{request.project}' not found under company '{request.company}'. "
    91→                f"Directory does not exist: {self.project_dir}"
    92→            )
    93→
    94→        # Generate unique orchestration ID
    95→        self.orchestration_id = datetime.now().strftime("%Y%m%d_%H%M%S")
    96→        self.orchestration_log_dir = self.logs_dir / self.orchestration_id
    97→        self.orchestration_log_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    98→        
    99→        logger.info(f"Initialized AgentOSOrchestrator with ID: {self.orchestration_id}")
   100→    
   101→    def run_workflow(self) -> OrchestrationResponse:
   102→        """
   103→        Execute the complete Agent-OS workflow for all spec intents.
   104→        
   105→        Returns:
   106→            OrchestrationResponse containing results of all steps
   107→        """
   108→        start_time = datetime.now()
   109→        all_results: List[StepResult] = []
   110→        spec_names_generated: List[str] = []
   111→        session_ids: Dict[str, str] = {}
   112→        
   113→        try:
   114→            logger.info(f"Starting orchestration for {len(self.request.spec_intents)} spec(s)")
   115→            
   116→            # Single shared executor using the active session
   117→            chat_executor = ClaudeChatExecutor(
   118→                company=self.request.company,
   119→                project=self.request.project,
   120→                workspace_dir=self.workspace_dir,
   121→                anthropic_api_key=self.anthropic_api_key
   122→            )
   123→            if self.session_id:
   124→                chat_executor.session_uuid = self.session_id
   125→
   126→            # Process each spec intent
   127→            for spec_idx, spec_intent in enumerate(self.request.spec_intents):
   128→                spec_name = spec_intent.spec_name
   129→                logger.info(f"Processing spec {spec_idx + 1}/{len(self.request.spec_intents)}: {spec_name} (session: {self.session_id})")
   130→
   131→                spec_names_generated.append(spec_name)
   132→                session_ids[spec_name] = self.session_id or chat_executor.session_uuid
   133→                
   134→                # REQUIRE existing spec with requirements.md — never create from scratch
   135→                spec_dir = self.project_dir / "agent-os" / "specs" / spec_name
   136→                requirements_file = spec_dir / "planning" / "requirements.md"
   137→
   138→                if not spec_dir.exists():
   139→                    error_msg = (
   140→                        f"Spec folder not found: agent-os/specs/{spec_name}. "
   141→                        f"Run /shape-spec first to create and shape this spec before orchestrating."
   142→                    )
   143→                    logger.error(error_msg)
   144→                    all_results.append(StepResult(
   145→                        step=0, command="pre-check",
   146→                        status="failure", output_paths=[],
   147→                        execution_time_seconds=0,
   148→                        log_file=self._create_step_log(0, "pre-check", {
   149→                            "success": False, "stdout": "", "stderr": error_msg,
   150→                            "execution_time": 0, "timestamp": datetime.now().isoformat()
   151→                        }),
   152→                        error_message=error_msg
   153→                    ))
   154→                    if self.request.options.stop_on_error:
   155→                        break
   156→                    continue
   157→
   158→                if not requirements_file.exists():
   159→                    error_msg = (
   160→                        f"Requirements not found: agent-os/specs/{spec_name}/planning/requirements.md. "
   161→                        f"Run /shape-spec first to gather requirements before orchestrating."
   162→                    )
   163→                    logger.error(error_msg)
   164→                    all_results.append(StepResult(
   165→                        step=0, command="pre-check",
   166→                        status="failure", output_paths=[],
   167→                        execution_time_seconds=0,
   168→                        log_file=self._create_step_log(0, "pre-check", {
   169→                            "success": False, "stdout": "", "stderr": error_msg,
   170→                            "execution_time": 0, "timestamp": datetime.now().isoformat()
   171→                        }),
   172→                        error_message=error_msg
   173→                    ))
   174→                    if self.request.options.stop_on_error:
   175→                        break
   176→                    continue
   177→
   178→                initialization_file = spec_dir / "planning" / "initialization.md"
   179→                if not initialization_file.exists():
   180→                    error_msg = (
   181→                        f"Spec '{spec_name}' is missing planning/initialization.md. "
   182→                        f"This file is created during /shape-spec and is required before orchestration. "
   183→                        f"Ensure the spec has been fully shaped before orchestrating."
   184→                    )
   185→                    logger.error(error_msg)
   186→                    all_results.append(StepResult(
   187→                        step=0, command="pre-check",
   188→                        status="failure", output_paths=[],
   189→                        execution_time_seconds=0,
   190→                        log_file=self._create_step_log(0, "pre-check", {
   191→                            "success": False, "stdout": "", "stderr": error_msg,
   192→                            "execution_time": 0, "timestamp": datetime.now().isoformat()
   193→                        }),
   194→                        error_message=error_msg
   195→                    ))
   196→                    if self.request.options.stop_on_error:
   197→                        break
   198→                    continue
   199→                
   200→                # Execute each command in sequence for this spec
   201→                for cmd_def in self.COMMANDS:
   202→                    step = cmd_def["step"]
   203→                    command = cmd_def["command"]
   204→                    description = cmd_def["description"]
   205→
   206→                    logger.info(f"Spec '{spec_name}' - Step {step}: {description} - Executing {command}")
   207→
   208→                    # Execute command using the shape-spec session
   209→                    step_result = self._execute_step_with_session(
   210→                        chat_executor=chat_executor,
   211→                        step=step,
   212→                        command=command,
   213→                        spec_name=spec_name
   214→                    )
   215→                    
   216→                    all_results.append(step_result)
   217→                    
   218→                    # Handle errors based on options
   219→                    if step_result.status == "failure":
   220→                        if self.request.options.stop_on_error:
   221→                            logger.error(f"Spec '{spec_name}' - Step {step} failed and stop_on_error is True. Stopping workflow.")
   222→                            break
   223→                        else:
   224→                            logger.warning(f"Spec '{spec_name}' - Step {step} failed but continuing due to stop_on_error=False")
   225→                
   226→                # If stop_on_error is True and we had a failure, stop processing more specs
   227→                if self.request.options.stop_on_error and any(r.status == "failure" for r in all_results):
   228→                    logger.error(f"Stopping orchestration due to failure in spec '{spec_name}'")
   229→                    break
   230→            
   231→            # Calculate total execution time
   232→            end_time = datetime.now()
   233→            total_time = (end_time - start_time).total_seconds()
   234→            
   235→            # Determine overall success
   236→            success = all(r.status == "success" for r in all_results)
   237→            
   238→            # Create main orchestration log
   239→            orchestration_log = self._create_orchestration_log(
   240→                spec_names=spec_names_generated,
   241→                results=all_results,
   242→                total_time=total_time,
   243→                success=success
   244→            )
   245→            
   246→            return OrchestrationResponse(
   247→                success=success,
   248→                spec_names=spec_names_generated,
   249→                session_ids=session_ids,
   250→                results=all_results,
   251→                total_execution_time_seconds=total_time,
   252→                orchestration_log=orchestration_log
   253→            )
   254→            
   255→        except Exception as e:
   256→            logger.error(f"Orchestration failed with exception: {str(e)}", exc_info=True)
   257→            
   258→            # Create error response
   259→            end_time = datetime.now()
   260→            total_time = (end_time - start_time).total_seconds()
   261→            
   262→            error_log = self._create_error_log(str(e), total_time)
   263→            
   264→            return OrchestrationResponse(
   265→                success=False,
   266→                spec_names=spec_names_generated,
   267→                session_ids=session_ids,
   268→                results=all_results,
   269→                total_execution_time_seconds=total_time,
   270→                orchestration_log=error_log
   271→            )
   272→    
   273→    def _execute_step_with_session(
   274→        self,
   275→        chat_executor: ClaudeChatExecutor,
   276→        step: int,
   277→        command: str,
   278→        spec_name: str
   279→    ) -> StepResult:
   280→        """
   281→        Execute a single workflow step by resuming the shape-spec Claude CLI session.
   282→
   283→        Args:
   284→            chat_executor: ClaudeChatExecutor configured with the spec's session_uuid
   285→            step: Step number (1-3)
   286→            command: The Agent-OS command to execute (e.g. "/write-spec")
   287→            spec_name: The spec directory name
   288→
   289→        Returns:
   290→            StepResult containing execution details
   291→        """
   292→        start_time = datetime.now()
   293→
   294→        # Build the prompt
   295→        prompt = f"{command} for {spec_name}"
   296→        if step == 3:
   297→            prompt += " — Implement ALL task groups without asking for confirmation."
   298→

   598→    def _build_implementation_package(self, spec_name: str) -> ImplementationPackage | None:
   599→        """Build a portable implementation package for a single spec."""
   600→        spec_dir = self.project_dir / "agent-os" / "specs" / spec_name

   602→
   603→        # Spec artifacts

   605→            ("planning/requirements.md", spec_dir / "planning" / "requirements.md"),
   606→            ("planning/initialization.md", spec_dir / "planning" / "initialization.md"),
   607→            ("spec.md", spec_dir / "spec.md"),
   608→            ("tasks.md", spec_dir / "tasks.md"),
   609→        ]
   610→
   611→        for rel, abs_path in artifact_paths:
   612→            if abs_path.exists():
   613→                try:
   614→                    content = abs_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
   615→                    files.append(ImplementationPackageFile(
   616→                        path=f"agent-os/specs/{spec_name}/{rel}",
   617→                        content=content,
   618→                    ))
   619→                except Exception as exc:
   620→                    logger.warning(f"Could not read {abs_path}: {exc}")
   621→
   622→        # implement-tasks.md skill template
   623→        skill_path = self.project_dir / ".claude" / "commands" / "implement-tasks.md"
   624→        if skill_path.exists():

   627→                files.append(ImplementationPackageFile(
   628→                    path=".claude/commands/implement-tasks.md",

   631→            except Exception as exc:

   633→
   634→        if not files:

   636→
   637→        return ImplementationPackage(
   638→            spec_name=spec_name,
   639→            company=self.request.company,
   640→            project=self.request.project,

```python
def create_feature_branch(self, branch_name: str) -> str:
    """Create and checkout a feature branch. Switches to it if it already exists."""
    # Check if branch already exists
    result = self._run_git(["git", "branch", "--list", branch_name], check=True)
    if branch_name in (result.stdout or ""):
        self._run_git(["git", "checkout", branch_name], check=True)
        logger.info("Switched to existing feature branch: %s", branch_name)
    else:
        self._run_git(["git", "checkout", self.default_branch], check=True)
        self._run_git(["git", "checkout", "-b", branch_name], check=True)
        logger.info("Created feature branch: %s", branch_name)
    return branch_name
```

**Key operations:**
- Uses `git branch --list` to check if branch exists

- Uses `git checkout` for existing branches (just switches)

- Active session from shape-spec

Flow:
1. Calls `_require_git_manager()` - validates git initialization
2. Retrieves active session
3. Creates `AgentOSOrchestrator` with session_id
4. Runs full workflow (write-spec → create-tasks → implement-tasks)
5. **Git commit and push per spec:**
   ```python
   branch = f"feature/{spec_name}"
   sha = gm.commit_all(f"feature: {spec_name} (write-spec + create-tasks + implement-tasks)")
   if git_config.auto_push and sha:
       gm.push_branch(branch)
       if git_config.auto_pr:
           gm.create_pull_request(title=..., branch=branch, body=...)
   ```
   (lines 2887-2903)
6. Populates response with git metadata:
   - `commit_sha`, `branch`, `pr_url`

#### **V2 (Brain-Only) - POST /api/v2/orchestrations/brain-only**
**File:** `/src/api.py` (lines 915-970)

Same as V2 full, but runs only `/write-spec` and `/create-tasks` (no `/implement-tasks`).
Returns `implementation_packages` for handoff to developer machines.

---

### **5. The Orchestrator Class**

**File:** `/src/agent_os_orchestrator.py`

Key characteristics:
- Expects pre-shaped specs (lines 37-38): *"Spec folders and requirements.md MUST be created by /shape-spec before orchestration"*
- Requires existing files (lines 135-199):
  - `agent-os/specs/{spec_name}` folder
  - `planning/requirements.md`
  - `planning/initialization.md`
- Executes steps with shared session (lines 116-124):
  ```python
  chat_executor = ClaudeChatExecutor(...)
  if self.session_id:
      chat_executor.session_uuid = self.session_id
  ```
- Persists session after each step (line 347):
  ```python
  chat_executor.persist_session_to_spec(spec_name)
  ```

---

### **6. Project Initialization (Git Prerequisite)**

**File:** `/src/api.py` (lines 2766-2823)

Endpoint: `POST /projects/init`

Initializes git repository for V2 endpoints:
1. Creates `.git` directory
2. Handles **brownfield** (clones existing repo) or **greenfield** (creates scaffold)
3. Git manager stored per (company, project)
4. Required before any V2 endpoint can use git operations

---

### **7. Git Configuration**

**File:** `/src/git/config.py` (lines 19-80)

Environment variables required:
- `GIT_PROVIDER`: "github" or "bitbucket"
- `GIT_DEFAULT_BRANCH`: default "main"
- `GIT_AUTO_PUSH`: default "true"
- `GIT_AUTO_PR`: default "true"
- `GITHUB_TOKEN` or `BITBUCKET_USERNAME` + `BITBUCKET_APP_PASSWORD`

---

### **Summary Diagram: Complete Request Flow**

```
CLIENT REQUEST
    ↓
[Shape-Spec Phase]
    ├─ V1: POST /api/v1/agent-os/shape-specs
    │   └─ Creates spec folder + requirements.md
    │   └─ Creates active_session.json
    │   └─ (NO git operations)
    │
    └─ V2: POST /api/v2/shape-spec/stream OR POST /api/v2/agent-os/shape-specs
        ├─ POST /projects/init (prerequisite)
        ├─ git pull origin {default_branch}
        ├─ /shape-spec command
        ├─ git checkout -b feature/{spec_name}
        └─ Creates active_session.json
    
[Orchestrate Phase]
    ├─ V1: POST /api/v1/orchestrations
    │   ├─ Get active_session.json
    │   ├─ Verify: spec folder, requirements.md, initialization.md exist
    │   ├─ Resume session (uuid from active_session.json)
    │   ├─ Execute: /write-spec → /create-tasks → /implement-tasks
    │   └─ Return: results, execution logs
    │
    └─ V2: POST /api/v2/orchestrations
        ├─ Get active_session.json
        ├─ Verify: spec folder, requirements.md, initialization.md exist
        ├─ Resume session
        ├─ Execute: /write-spec → /create-tasks → /implement-tasks
        ├─ For each spec:
        │   ├─ git commit -m "feature: {spec_name} (...)"
        │   ├─ git push origin feature/{spec_name}
        │   └─ Create PR (if auto_pr=true)
        └─ Return: results + commit_sha, branch, pr_url
```

    "/api/v2/jobs/orchestrations",
    tags=["Git Integration"],
    summary="Create async orchestration job with git integration (V2)",
    response_model=JobResponse,
    responses={
        400: {"description": "Missing prerequisites or git config"},
        401: {"description": "Invalid or missing API key"},

    },

async def create_orchestration_job_v2(
    request: OrchestrationRequest,
    background_tasks: BackgroundTasks,
    authenticated: bool = Depends(verify_api_key),
):
    """
    Git-integrated async orchestration. Creates a background job that runs
    the full orchestration workflow with git commit/push/PR after completion.

    Returns immediately with a `job_id`. Poll `GET /api/v2/jobs/{job_id}` for status.

    Requires: `POST /projects/init` must have been called first.
    """
    # Validate git preconditions upfront
    _require_git_manager(request.company, request.project)

    try:
        # Create job
        job = Job(
            type=JobType.ORCHESTRATION,
            company=request.company,
            project=request.project,
            request_payload=request.model_dump(),
        )

        # Enqueue
        job_id = job_queue.enqueue_job(job)

        # Run in background thread
        background_tasks.add_task(_run_job_in_background, job_id)

        logger.info(f"V2 orchestration job created and dispatched: {job_id}")

        return JobResponse(
            job_id=job_id,
            status=JobStatus.QUEUED,
            created_at=job.created_at,
        )

    except Exception as e:
        logger.error(f"Failed to create V2 orchestration job: {str(e)}", exc_info=True)
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_500_INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR,
            detail=f"Failed to create orchestration job: {str(e)}",
        )

def _run_job_in_background(job_id: str):
    """
    Execute a queued job in-process (no separate worker needed).
    Reads the job from storage, runs the appropriate task function,
    and updates the job status on completion or failure.
    """
    from .job_queue.tasks import run_orchestration
    storage = job_queue.storage

    job = storage.get_job(job_id)
    if not job:
        logger.error(f"Background job runner: job {job_id} not found")
        return

    try:
        if job.type == JobType.ORCHESTRATION:
            run_orchestration(job_id, storage)
        else:
            logger.error(f"Background job runner: unsupported job type {job.type}")
            job.status = JobStatus.FAILED
            job.completed_at = datetime.utcnow()
            job.error = f"Unsupported job type: {job.type}"
            storage.save_job(job)
    except Exception as e:
        logger.error(f"Background job runner: job {job_id} failed: {e}", exc_info=True)
        # tasks.run_orchestration already marks the job as FAILED, but guard just in case
        job = storage.get_job(job_id)
        if job and job.status != JobStatus.FAILED:
            job.status = JobStatus.FAILED
            job.completed_at = datetime.utcnow()
            job.error = str(e)
            storage.save_job(job)

"""
Task functions executed by workers.

This module contains the actual execution logic for different job types.
Each function takes a job_id and storage object, retrieves the job,
executes the work, and updates the job status.
"""

import os
from pathlib import Path
import logging
from datetime import datetime
from .job_storage import JobStorage
from .job_models import JobStatus
from ..agent_os_orchestrator import AgentOSOrchestrator
from ..agent_os_models import OrchestrationRequest
from ..chat.session_store import get_active_session
from ..git.config import load_git_config, GitConfigError
from ..git.git_manager import GitManager, GitManagerError

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


def run_orchestration(job_id: str, storage: JobStorage):
    """
    Execute orchestration job.
    
    This function runs the full Agent-OS orchestration workflow:
    1. /write-spec
    2. /create-tasks
    3. /implement-tasks
    
    Args:
        job_id: Unique identifier for the job
        storage: JobStorage instance for persisting job state
    """
    job = storage.get_job(job_id)
    if not job:
        raise ValueError(f"Job {job_id} not found")
    
    try:
        # Update to running
        job.status = JobStatus.RUNNING
        job.started_at = datetime.utcnow()
        job.worker_id = os.getenv("WORKER_ID", "worker-1")
        storage.save_job(job)
        
        logger.info(f"Starting orchestration job {job_id}")
        
        # Create request from payload
        request = OrchestrationRequest(**job.request_payload)
        
        # Get API key
        anthropic_api_key = os.getenv("ANTHROPIC_API_KEY")
        if not anthropic_api_key:
            raise ValueError("ANTHROPIC_API_KEY not configured")
        
        # Create orchestrator
        # API_WORKSPACE_DIR is required
        workspace_dir = os.getenv("API_WORKSPACE_DIR")
        if not workspace_dir:
            raise ValueError("API_WORKSPACE_DIR environment variable is required.")
        logs_dir = os.getenv("ORCHESTRATION_LOG_DIR", f"{workspace_dir}/logs/orchestration")
        
        # Resolve active session
        session_id = get_active_session(Path(workspace_dir), request.company, request.project)
        if not session_id:
            raise ValueError(
                f"No active session for {request.company}/{request.project}. Run shape-spec first."
            )

        orchestrator = AgentOSOrchestrator(
            request=request,
            anthropic_api_key=anthropic_api_key,
            workspace_dir=workspace_dir,
            logs_dir=logs_dir,
            session_id=session_id,
        )
        
        # Run workflow
        logger.info(f"Running orchestration workflow for job {job_id}")
        response = orchestrator.run_workflow()

        # Git operations: commit, push, PR per spec
        try:
            git_config = load_git_config()
            project_dir = Path(workspace_dir) / request.company / request.project
            gm = GitManager(
                project_dir=str(project_dir),
                provider=git_config.provider,
                default_branch=git_config.default_branch,
                github_token=git_config.github_token,
                bitbucket_username=git_config.bitbucket_username,
                bitbucket_app_password=git_config.bitbucket_app_password,
            )

            for spec_intent in request.spec_intents:
                spec_name = spec_intent.spec_name
                branch = f"feature/{spec_name}"

                try:
                    sha = gm.commit_all(f"feature: {spec_name} (write-spec + create-tasks + implement-tasks)")
                    if git_config.auto_push and sha:
                        gm.push_branch(branch)
                        if git_config.auto_pr:
                            pr_url = gm.create_pull_request(
                                title=f"feature: {spec_name}",
                                branch=branch,
                                body=f"Orchestration output for {spec_name}",
                            )
                            response.pr_url = pr_url
                        response.commit_sha = sha
                        response.branch = branch
                    logger.info(f"Git commit/push/PR done for {spec_name}: sha={sha}")
                except GitManagerError as e:
                    logger.error(f"Git push/PR failed for {spec_name}: {e}")

                try:
                    gm._run_git(["git", "checkout", gm.default_branch], check=False)
                except Exception:
                    pass

        except (GitConfigError, GitManagerError) as e:
            logger.warning(f"Git integration skipped for job {job_id}: {e}")

        # Update with result
        job.status = JobStatus.COMPLETED
        job.completed_at = datetime.utcnow()
        job.result = response.dict()
        storage.save_job(job)

        logger.info(f"Orchestration job {job_id} completed successfully")
        
    except Exception as e:
        # Update with error
        logger.error(f"Orchestration job {job_id} failed: {str(e)}", exc_info=True)
        job.status = JobStatus.FAILED
        job.completed_at = datetime.utcnow()
        job.error = str(e)
        storage.save_job(job)
        raise


# Placeholder functions for Phase 2+ expansion
def run_write_spec(job_id: str, storage: JobStorage):
    """Execute write-spec job (Phase 2+)."""
    raise NotImplementedError("write-spec jobs not yet implemented")


def run_generate_tasks(job_id: str, storage: JobStorage):
    """Execute generate-tasks job (Phase 2+)."""
    raise NotImplementedError("generate-tasks jobs not yet implemented")


def run_implement_tasks(job_id: str, storage: JobStorage):
    """Execute implement-tasks job (Phase 2+)."""
    raise NotImplementedError("implement-tasks jobs not yet implemented")


def run_shape_spec(job_id: str, storage: JobStorage):
    """Execute shape-spec job (Phase 2+)."""
    raise NotImplementedError("shape-spec jobs not yet implemented")


def run_standards_product(job_id: str, storage: JobStorage):
    """Execute standards-product job (Phase 2+)."""
    raise NotImplementedError("standards-product jobs not yet implemented")


def run_standards_global(job_id: str, storage: JobStorage):
    """Execute standards-global job (Phase 2+)."""
    raise NotImplementedError("standards-global jobs not yet implemented")

Now I have the full picture. Here's the analysis:

---

## Current Flow (V2)

```
1. POST /api/v2/shape-spec/stream  (session_mode: "new")
   ├─ git pull latest
   ├─ Run /shape-spec via Claude CLI
   ├─ On "folder" SSE event → gm.create_feature_branch("feature/{folder_name}")  ← BRANCH CREATED HERE
   └─ Returns SSE stream with questions/folder events

2. POST /api/v2/jobs/orchestrations
   ├─ Validates git manager exists (_require_git_manager)
   ├─ Enqueues job, returns job_id immediately
   └─ Background task (tasks.py:run_orchestration):
       ├─ Runs orchestrator.run_workflow() (write-spec → create-tasks → implement-tasks)
       ├─ ASSUMES branch "feature/{spec_name}" already exists
       ├─ gm.commit_all() on the current branch
       ├─ gm.push_branch(branch)
       ├─ gm.create_pull_request()
       └─ Switches back to default branch
```

**The problem:** The feature branch is created during shape-spec (line `api.py:3017`), before orchestration even starts. This means:

- A branch exists with only `requirements.md` and `initialization.md` on it — no spec, no tasks, no implementation yet
- If the user never orchestrates, you have an orphaned branch
- If shape-spec fails after branch creation, you have a dirty branch

---

## Proposed Flow (Defer branch creation to orchestration completion)

```
1. POST /api/v2/shape-spec/stream  (session_mode: "new")
   ├─ git pull latest
   ├─ Run /shape-spec via Claude CLI (stays on default branch)
   ├─ On "folder" SSE event → just emit the event, NO branch creation
   └─ Spec folder created on the default branch (uncommitted working tree)

2. POST /api/v2/jobs/orchestrations
   ├─ Validates git manager exists
   ├─ Enqueues job, returns job_id immediately
   └─ Background task (tasks.py:run_orchestration):
       ├─ Runs orchestrator.run_workflow() on default branch (working tree)
       ├─ AFTER workflow completes successfully:
       │   ├─ gm.create_feature_branch("feature/{spec_name}")  ← BRANCH CREATED HERE
       │   ├─ gm.commit_all()
       │   ├─ gm.push_branch()
       │   └─ gm.create_pull_request()
       └─ Switches back to default branch
```

---

## Key Differences

| Aspect | Current | Proposed |
|--------|---------|----------|
| **Branch creation timing** | During shape-spec stream (on "folder" event) | After orchestration job completes successfully |
| **Branch creation location** | `api.py:3017` (shape_spec_stream_v2) | `tasks.py:~99` (run_orchestration) |
| **Work happens on** | Feature branch (shape-spec + orchestration) | Default branch working tree until commit |
| **Failed orchestration** | Leaves orphaned feature branch | No branch created — clean state |
| **Shape-spec without orchestration** | Orphaned branch with only requirements | No branch — just uncommitted files |
| **Concurrency risk** | Lower (isolated branch early) | Higher (all specs share default branch working tree until committed) |

## Changes Required

1. **`api.py:3013-3020`** — Remove `create_feature_branch` call from `shape_spec_stream_v2`. Keep the "folder" event emission but skip the git branch logic.

2. **`tasks.py:97-121`** — Add `gm.create_feature_branch(branch)` call *before* `gm.commit_all()` so the branch is created only after `run_workflow()` succeeds.

3. **`api.py:3463-3608`** (batch shape-specs V2) — Same treatment: remove branch creation from the batch endpoint.

## Concurrency Concern

The main tradeoff: in the current flow, each spec gets its own branch immediately, so parallel shape-spec calls don't collide. In the proposed flow, all shape-spec output lands in the working tree on the default branch. If two specs are shaped concurrently, their files could intermingle before being branched. This is mitigated by the fact that spec folders are already namespaced (`agent-os/specs/{spec_name}/`), but git operations (checkout, commit) aren't atomic across concurrent jobs. You may want to add a lock or ensure orchestration jobs for the same project are serialized.

) -> ShapeSpecResponse:
    """
    Git-integrated batch shape-specs. For each spec intent, creates a feature
    branch after the spec folder is created.

    Same behavior as V1 but requires initialized project and creates feature branches.
    """
    gm = _require_git_manager(request.company, request.project)

    try:
        gm.pull_latest()
    except GitManagerError as e:
        logger.warning(f"git pull failed before batch shape-specs: {e}")

    # Delegate to v1 logic
    try:
        import re
        from datetime import datetime as dt

        config = load_env_config()
        anthropic_api_key = config.get("anthropic_api_key")
        if not anthropic_api_key:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=500, detail="ANTHROPIC_API_KEY not configured")

        project_dir = API_WORKSPACE_DIR / request.company / request.project

        # Verify product files exist
        product_dir = project_dir / "agent-os" / "product"
        required_files = ["mission.md", "roadmap.md", "tech-stack.md"]
        missing_files = [
            str(product_dir / f) for f in required_files if not (product_dir / f).exists()
        ]
        if missing_files:
            raise HTTPException(
                status_code=400,
                detail=f"Required product planning files missing: {', '.join(missing_files)}. Run /plan-product first.",
            )

        from .claude_cli_executor import ClaudeCLIExecutor

        cli_executor = ClaudeCLIExecutor(
            project_dir=str(project_dir), anthropic_api_key=anthropic_api_key
        )

        start_time = dt.now()
        results = []

        for spec_intent in request.spec_intents:
            intent_start = dt.now()
            try:
                system_prompt = f"""You are shaping a specification from this spec intent:

{spec_intent}

Follow the /shape-spec workflow to:
1. Analyze the intent and decide an appropriate spec name
2. Initialize the spec folder structure
3. Research requirements by reviewing the product context files
4. Save complete requirements to planning/requirements.md

Do not ask the user questions - make reasonable assumptions based on best practices and the product context files (mission.md, roadmap.md, tech-stack.md).
"""
                loop = asyncio.get_event_loop()
                exec_result = await loop.run_in_executor(
                    executor_pool, cli_executor.execute, "/shape-spec", system_prompt
                )

                intent_end = dt.now()
                execution_time = (intent_end - intent_start).total_seconds()

                specs_dir = project_dir / "agent-os" / "specs"
                spec_name = None
                spec_path = None

                if exec_result["success"] and specs_dir.exists():
                    spec_dirs = sorted(specs_dir.iterdir(), key=lambda p: p.stat().st_mtime, reverse=True)
                    if spec_dirs:
                        spec_path = spec_dirs[0]
                        spec_name = spec_path.name

                if spec_name and spec_path:
                    # Create feature branch for this spec
                    try:
                        gm.create_feature_branch(f"feature/{spec_name}")
                    except GitManagerError as e:
                        logger.error(f"Failed to create feature branch for {spec_name}: {e}")

                    result = ShapeSpecResult(
                        spec_name=spec_name,
                        spec_intent=spec_intent[:200] + "..." if len(spec_intent) > 200 else spec_intent,
                        status="success",
                        spec_path=str(spec_path).replace("\\", "/"),
                        requirements_path=str(spec_path / "planning" / "requirements.md").replace("\\", "/")
                        if (spec_path / "planning" / "requirements.md").exists()
                        else None,
                        initialization_path=str(spec_path / "planning" / "initialization.md").replace("\\", "/")
                        if (spec_path / "planning" / "initialization.md").exists()
                        else None,
                        execution_time_seconds=execution_time,
                        error_message=None,
                    )
                else:
                    result = ShapeSpecResult(
                        spec_name="",
                        spec_intent=spec_intent[:200] + "..." if len(spec_intent) > 200 else spec_intent,
                        status="failure",
                        spec_path="",
                        requirements_path=None,
                        initialization_path=None,
                        execution_time_seconds=execution_time,
                        error_message="Failed to create spec directory or determine spec name",
                    )
                results.append(result)

                # Switch back to default branch for next spec
                try:
                    gm._run_git(["git", "checkout", gm.default_branch], check=False)
                except Exception:
                    pass

            except Exception as e:
                intent_end = dt.now()
                execution_time = (intent_end - intent_start).total_seconds()
                result = ShapeSpecResult(
                    spec_name="",
                    spec_intent=spec_intent[:200] + "..." if len(spec_intent) > 200 else spec_intent,
                    status="failure",
                    spec_path="",
                    execution_time_seconds=execution_time,
                    error_message=str(e),
                )
                results.append(result)

        end_time = dt.now()
        total_time = (end_time - start_time).total_seconds()
        success = all(r.status == "success" for r in results)

        return ShapeSpecResponse(
            success=success,
            results=results,
            total_execution_time_seconds=total_time,
            timestamp=dt.now().isoformat(),
        )

    except HTTPException:
        raise

- **Production**: Single optimized image (Dockerfile)
- **Development**: Hot-reload enabled for source code changes (Dockerfile.dev + docker-compose.dev.yml)
- **Testing**: Separate test container on port 8001 for parallel testing (docker-compose.test.yml)

# Deferred Branch Creation: Shape-Spec → Orchestration

## Summary

Move git feature branch creation from the shape-spec phase to the orchestration job completion phase. Branches should only be created when an async orchestration job (`POST /api/v2/jobs/orchestrations`) completes successfully — not when a new shape-spec API request is made.

---

## Current Flow

```
1. POST /api/v2/shape-spec/stream  (session_mode: "new")
   ├─ git pull latest
   ├─ Run /shape-spec via Claude CLI
   ├─ On "folder" SSE event → gm.create_feature_branch("feature/{folder_name}")  ← BRANCH CREATED HERE
   └─ Returns SSE stream with questions/folder events

2. POST /api/v2/jobs/orchestrations
   ├─ Validates git manager exists (_require_git_manager)
   ├─ Enqueues job, returns job_id immediately
   └─ Background task (tasks.py:run_orchestration):
       ├─ Runs orchestrator.run_workflow() (write-spec → create-tasks → implement-tasks)
       ├─ ASSUMES branch "feature/{spec_name}" already exists
       ├─ gm.commit_all() on the current branch
       ├─ gm.push_branch(branch)
       ├─ gm.create_pull_request()
       └─ Switches back to default branch
```

### Current flow issues

- A branch is created during shape-spec with only `requirements.md` and `initialization.md` — no spec, no tasks, no implementation yet.
- If the user never orchestrates, an orphaned feature branch remains.
- If shape-spec fails after branch creation, a dirty/incomplete branch is left behind.

---

## Proposed Flow

```
1. POST /api/v2/shape-spec/stream  (session_mode: "new")
   ├─ git pull latest
   ├─ Run /shape-spec via Claude CLI (stays on default branch)
   ├─ On "folder" SSE event → emit event only, NO branch creation
   └─ Spec folder created on the default branch (uncommitted working tree)

2. POST /api/v2/jobs/orchestrations
   ├─ Validates git manager exists
   ├─ Enqueues job, returns job_id immediately
   └─ Background task (tasks.py:run_orchestration):
       ├─ Runs orchestrator.run_workflow() on default branch (working tree)
       ├─ AFTER workflow completes successfully:
       │   ├─ gm.create_feature_branch("feature/{spec_name}")  ← BRANCH CREATED HERE
       │   ├─ gm.commit_all()
       │   ├─ gm.push_branch()
       │   └─ gm.create_pull_request()
       └─ Switches back to default branch
```

---

## Key Differences

| Aspect | Current | Proposed |
|--------|---------|----------|
| **Branch creation timing** | During shape-spec stream (on "folder" event) | After orchestration job completes successfully |
| **Branch creation location** | `src/api.py` shape_spec_stream_v2 | `src/job_queue/tasks.py` run_orchestration |
| **Work happens on** | Feature branch (shape-spec + orchestration) | Default branch working tree until commit |
| **Failed orchestration** | Leaves orphaned feature branch | No branch created — clean state |
| **Shape-spec without orchestration** | Orphaned branch with only requirements | No branch — just uncommitted files |

---

## Code Changes

### 1. `src/api.py` — `shape_spec_stream_v2` (~line 3013)

Remove `gm.create_feature_branch()` call from the "folder" event handler. Keep the "folder" event emission.

### 2. `src/api.py` — `create_shape_specs_v2` (~line 3549)

Remove `gm.create_feature_branch()` call and the subsequent checkout back to default branch.

### 3. `src/job_queue/tasks.py` — `run_orchestration` (~line 97)

Add `gm.create_feature_branch(branch)` call before `gm.commit_all()`, so the branch is created only after `run_workflow()` succeeds.

---

## Concurrency Concern

In the current flow, each spec gets its own branch immediately during shape-spec, so parallel shape-spec calls don't collide. In the proposed flow, all shape-spec output lands in the working tree on the default branch. If two specs are shaped concurrently, their files could intermingle before being branched.

**Mitigating factors:**
- Spec folders are already namespaced (`agent-os/specs/{spec_name}/`), so file-level collisions are unlikely.
- The orchestration job creates the branch and commits atomically per spec.

**Remaining risk:**
- Git operations (checkout, commit) aren't atomic across concurrent jobs. Two concurrent orchestration jobs for the same project could race on branch checkout/commit.
- This is acknowledged but **not addressed** in this change. A future enhancement could add a per-project lock or serialize orchestration jobs for the same project.

       │   └─ gm.create_pull_request()
       └─ Switches back to default branch
```

## Key Differences

| Aspect | Current | Proposed |
|--------|---------|----------|
| **Branch creation timing** | During shape-spec stream (on "folder" event) | After orchestration job completes successfully |
| **Branch creation location** | `src/api.py` shape_spec_stream_v2 | `src/job_queue/tasks.py` run_orchestration |
| **Work happens on** | Feature branch (shape-spec + orchestration) | Default branch working tree until commit |
| **Failed orchestration** | Leaves orphaned feature branch | No branch created — clean state |
| **Shape-spec without orchestration** | Orphaned branch with only requirements | No branch — just uncommitted files |

### 1. `src/api.py` — `shape_spec_stream_v2` (~line 3013)

Remove `gm.create_feature_branch()` call from the "folder" event handler. Keep the "folder" event emission.

### 2. `src/api.py` — `create_shape_specs_v2` (~line 3549)

Remove `gm.create_feature_branch()` call and the subsequent checkout back to default branch.

### 3. `src/job_queue/tasks.py` — `run_orchestration` (~line 97)

Add `gm.create_feature_branch(branch)` call before `gm.commit_all()`, so the branch is created only after `run_workflow()` succeeds.

---

## Concurrency Concern

In the current flow, each spec gets its own branch immediately during shape-spec, so parallel shape-spec calls don't collide. In the proposed flow, all shape-spec output lands in the working tree on the default branch. If two specs are shaped concurrently, their files could intermingle before being branched.

**Mitigating factors:**
- Spec folders are already namespaced (`agent-os/specs/{spec_name}/`), so file-level collisions are unlikely.
- The orchestration job creates the branch and commits atomically per spec.

**Remaining risk:**
- Git operations (checkout, commit) aren't atomic across concurrent jobs. Two concurrent orchestration jobs for the same project could race on branch checkout/commit.
- This is acknowledged but **not addressed** in this change. A future enhancement could add a per-project lock or serialize orchestration jobs for the same project.

def sanitize_path(path_str: str) -> Path:
    """
    Sanitize and validate path to prevent directory traversal.
    
    All paths are treated as relative to API_WORKSPACE_DIR.
    Path traversal attempts (../) are blocked.
    
    Args:
        path_str: Path string from client
        
    Returns:
        Absolute path within API_WORKSPACE_DIR
        
    Raises:
        HTTPException: If path traversal is detected
    """
    # Convert to Path object
    path = Path(path_str)
    
    # Check for path traversal attempts
    if ".." in path.parts:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST,
            detail=f"Path traversal not allowed: {path_str}"
        )
    
    # Make absolute relative to workspace
    absolute_path = (API_WORKSPACE_DIR / path).resolve()
    
    # Ensure it's still within workspace (double-check)
    try:
        absolute_path.relative_to(API_WORKSPACE_DIR)
    except ValueError:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST,
            detail=f"Path must be within workspace: {path_str}"
        )
    
    return absolute_path

async def orchestrate_features(

    """
    Orchestrate the complete Agent-OS workflow for one or more specs (**synchronous — waits for completion**).

    Runs: `/write-spec` -> `/create-tasks` -> `/implement-tasks`, resuming the
    Claude CLI session from `/shape-spec`.

    For long-running orchestrations, prefer the async job endpoint
    `POST /api/v1/jobs/orchestrations` to avoid HTTP timeouts.

    **Prerequisites:**
    - Run shape-spec first (creates `requirements.md` and `initialization.md`)
    - Product planning files must exist: `mission.md`, `roadmap.md`, `tech-stack.md`

    **Example request (single spec):**
    ```json
    {
      "company": "acme",
      "project": "backend",
      "spec_intents": [
        {
          "spec_name": "2026-02-21-user-registration",
          "session_id": "91c30231-cf7a-51e4-ba3f-585e5e1694d7"
        }
      ]
    }
    ```

    **Example request (multiple specs):**
    ```json
    {
      "company": "acme",
      "project": "backend",
      "spec_intents": [
        {"spec_name": "2026-02-21-user-registration", "session_id": "session-1"},
        {"spec_name": "2026-02-21-payment-gateway", "session_id": "session-2"}
      ],
      "options": {
        "stop_on_error": true,
        "retry_on_failure": false,
        "max_retries": 1,
        "timeout_seconds": null
      }
    }
    ```
    """
    try:
        # Get Anthropic API key from environment
        config = load_env_config()
        anthropic_api_key = config.get('anthropic_api_key')
        
        if not anthropic_api_key:
            raise HTTPException(
                status_code=status.HTTP_500_INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR,
                detail="ANTHROPIC_API_KEY not configured on server"
            )
        
        # Resolve active session for this project
        session_id = get_active_session(API_WORKSPACE_DIR, request.company, request.project)
        if not session_id:
            raise HTTPException(
                status_code=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST,
                detail=f"No active session for {request.company}/{request.project}. Run shape-spec first."
            )

        # Create orchestrator with the active session
        orchestrator = AgentOSOrchestrator(
            request=request,
            anthropic_api_key=anthropic_api_key,
            workspace_dir=str(API_WORKSPACE_DIR),
            logs_dir=str(ORCHESTRATION_LOG_DIR),
            session_id=session_id,
        )

        # Run workflow in thread pool
        loop = asyncio.get_event_loop()
        response = await loop.run_in_executor(
            executor_pool,
            orchestrator.run_workflow
        )
        
        return response
        
    except HTTPException:

            status_code=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST,

@app.get(
    "/api/v2/orchestrations/{company}/{project}/{spec_name}/package",
    tags=["Orchestration"],
    summary="Download implementation package as ZIP",
    responses={
        200: {"content": {"application/zip": {}}, "description": "ZIP file with implementation artifacts"},
        401: {"description": "Invalid or missing API key"},
        404: {"description": "Spec or artifacts not found"},
    },
)
async def get_implementation_package_zip(
    company: str,
    project: str,
    spec_name: str,
    authenticated: bool = Depends(verify_api_key)
):
    """
    Download the portable implementation package as a ZIP file.

    The ZIP is drop-in ready: extract into your project root and run
    `claude /implement-tasks for {spec_name}`.

    Contents:
    - `agent-os/specs/{spec_name}/planning/requirements.md`
    - `agent-os/specs/{spec_name}/planning/initialization.md`
    - `agent-os/specs/{spec_name}/spec.md`
    - `agent-os/specs/{spec_name}/tasks.md`
    - `.claude/commands/implement-tasks.md`
    """
    import io
    import zipfile
    from fastapi.responses import Response

    project_dir = API_WORKSPACE_DIR / company / project
    spec_dir = project_dir / "agent-os" / "specs" / spec_name

    if not spec_dir.exists():
        raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND, detail=f"Spec '{spec_name}' not found")

    # Collect files
    file_map: dict[str, Path] = {}
    for rel in [
        f"agent-os/specs/{spec_name}/planning/requirements.md",
        f"agent-os/specs/{spec_name}/planning/initialization.md",
        f"agent-os/specs/{spec_name}/spec.md",
        f"agent-os/specs/{spec_name}/tasks.md",
    ]:
        abs_path = project_dir / rel
        if abs_path.exists():
            file_map[rel] = abs_path

    skill_path = project_dir / ".claude" / "commands" / "implement-tasks.md"
    if skill_path.exists():
        file_map[".claude/commands/implement-tasks.md"] = skill_path

    if not file_map:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND, detail="No artifacts found for this spec")

    # Build ZIP in memory
    buf = io.BytesIO()
    with zipfile.ZipFile(buf, "w", zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as zf:
        for rel_path, abs_path in file_map.items():
            zf.writestr(rel_path, abs_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    buf.seek(0)

    return Response(
        content=buf.getvalue(),
        media_type="application/zip",
        headers={"Content-Disposition": f'attachment; filename="{spec_name}-implementation-package.zip"'},
    )

@app.get(
    "/api/v1/orchestrations/{orchestration_id}/status",
    tags=["Orchestration"],
    summary="Get orchestration status",
    response_model=OrchestrationStatusResponse,
    responses={401: {"description": "Invalid or missing API key"}, 404: {"description": "Orchestration not found"}, 500: {"description": "Server error"}},
)
async def get_orchestration_status(
    orchestration_id: str,
    authenticated: bool = Depends(verify_api_key)
) -> OrchestrationStatusResponse:
    """
    Get the status of a running or completed orchestration.

    The `orchestration_id` uses the format `YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS`.

    **Possible statuses:** `running`, `completed`, `failed`.

    **Example:**
    ```
    GET /api/v1/orchestrations/20260116_171820/status
    ```
    """
    import json
    
    try:
        # Find orchestration log directory
        orchestration_dir = ORCHESTRATION_LOG_DIR / orchestration_id
        
        if not orchestration_dir.exists():
            raise HTTPException(
                status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND,
                detail=f"Orchestration {orchestration_id} not found"
            )
        
        # Check for completion files
        orchestration_log = orchestration_dir / "orchestration.json"
        error_log = orchestration_dir / "error.json"
        
        if orchestration_log.exists():
            # Orchestration completed
            with open(orchestration_log, 'r') as f:
                log_data = json.load(f)
            
            return OrchestrationStatusResponse(
                orchestration_id=orchestration_id,
                status="completed",
                company=log_data.get("project_dir", "").split("/")[-2] if "/" in log_data.get("project_dir", "") else "",
                project=log_data.get("project_dir", "").split("/")[-1] if "/" in log_data.get("project_dir", "") else "",
                spec_names=log_data.get("spec_names", []),
                completed_steps=len(log_data.get("steps", [])),
                total_steps=4,
                elapsed_time_seconds=log_data.get("total_execution_time_seconds"),
                success=log_data.get("success", False),
                log_file=str(orchestration_log).replace("\\", "/")
            )
        
        elif error_log.exists():
            # Orchestration failed
            with open(error_log, 'r') as f:
                log_data = json.load(f)
            
            return OrchestrationStatusResponse(
                orchestration_id=orchestration_id,
                status="failed",
                company="",
                project="",
                spec_names=[],
                completed_steps=0,
                total_steps=4,
                elapsed_time_seconds=log_data.get("total_execution_time_seconds"),
                success=False,
                log_file=str(error_log).replace("\\", "/")
            )
        
        else:
            # Orchestration is running - check step logs
            step_logs = sorted(orchestration_dir.glob("step-*.json"))
            completed_steps = len(step_logs)
            
            current_step = None
            current_command = None
            
            if step_logs:
                # Read the most recent step log
                with open(step_logs[-1], 'r') as f:
                    last_step_data = json.load(f)
                    current_step = last_step_data.get("step")
                    current_command = last_step_data.get("command")
            
            # Calculate elapsed time from orchestration_id
            from datetime import datetime
            start_time = datetime.strptime(orchestration_id, "%Y%m%d_%H%M%S")
            elapsed_seconds = (datetime.now() - start_time).total_seconds()
            
            return OrchestrationStatusResponse(
                orchestration_id=orchestration_id,
                status="running",
                company="",
                project="",
                spec_names=[],
                current_step=current_step,
                current_command=current_command,
                completed_steps=completed_steps,
                total_steps=4,
                elapsed_time_seconds=elapsed_seconds,
                log_file=str(orchestration_dir).replace("\\", "/")
            )
    
    except HTTPException:
        raise
    except Exception as e:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_500_INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR,
            detail=f"Failed to get orchestration status: {str(e)}"
        )


@app.get(
    "/api/v1/orchestrations/{orchestration_id}/logs",
    tags=["Orchestration"],
    summary="Get orchestration logs",
    response_model=OrchestrationLogsResponse,
    responses={401: {"description": "Invalid or missing API key"}, 404: {"description": "Orchestration not found"}, 500: {"description": "Server error"}},
)
async def get_orchestration_logs(
    orchestration_id: str,
    step: Optional[int] = None,
    authenticated: bool = Depends(verify_api_key)
) -> OrchestrationLogsResponse:
    """
    Get logs from a running or completed orchestration.

    Optionally filter by step number (0=shape-spec, 1=write-spec,
    2=create-tasks, 3=implement-tasks).

    **Examples:**
    ```
    GET /api/v1/orchestrations/20260116_171820/logs
    GET /api/v1/orchestrations/20260116_171820/logs?step=0
    ```
    """
    import json
    
    try:
        # Find orchestration log directory
        orchestration_dir = ORCHESTRATION_LOG_DIR / orchestration_id
        
        if not orchestration_dir.exists():
            raise HTTPException(
                status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND,
                detail=f"Orchestration {orchestration_id} not found"
            )
        
        logs = []
        
        # If step is specified, read only that step's log
        if step is not None:
            step_log_files = list(orchestration_dir.glob(f"step-{step}-*.json"))
        else:
            # Read all step logs
            step_log_files = sorted(orchestration_dir.glob("step-*.json"))
        
        for log_file in step_log_files:
            try:
                with open(log_file, 'r') as f:
                    log_data = json.load(f)
                
                # Extract stdout and stderr as log entries
                if log_data.get("stdout"):
                    logs.append(StepLogEntry(
                        timestamp=log_data.get("timestamp", ""),
                        level="INFO",
                        message=log_data["stdout"],
                        source="claude"
                    ))
                
                if log_data.get("stderr"):
                    logs.append(StepLogEntry(
                        timestamp=log_data.get("timestamp", ""),
                        level="ERROR",
                        message=log_data["stderr"],
                        source="claude"
                    ))
                
                # Add execution summary
                summary = f"Step {log_data.get('step')}: {log_data.get('command')} - Status: {'success' if log_data.get('success') else 'failure'} - Duration: {log_data.get('execution_time', 0):.2f}s"
                logs.append(StepLogEntry(
                    timestamp=log_data.get("timestamp", ""),
                    level="INFO",
                    message=summary,
                    source="orchestrator"
                ))
            
            except Exception as e:
                logger.error(f"Failed to read log file {log_file}: {e}")
                continue
        
        return OrchestrationLogsResponse(
            orchestration_id=orchestration_id,
            logs=logs,
            has_more=False
        )
    
    except HTTPException:
        raise
    except Exception as e:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_500_INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR,
            detail=f"Failed to get orchestration logs: {str(e)}"
        )

async def create_shape_specs(
    request: ShapeSpecRequest,
    authenticated: bool = Depends(verify_api_key)
) -> ShapeSpecResponse:
    """
    Create one or more shape-specs by running the `/shape-spec` command (batch mode).

    Initializes spec folders and gathers requirements **without** running the
    full orchestration workflow. Each `spec_intent` must be at least 50 characters.

    **Prerequisites:**
    - Product planning files must exist: `mission.md`, `roadmap.md`, `tech-stack.md`
    - Run `/plan-product` first if these files don't exist

    **Example request:**
    ```json
    {
      "company": "acme",
      "project": "backend",
      "spec_intents": [
        "title: User Registration\\n\\ncontext: We need a user registration flow...\\n\\ngoal: Allow users to sign up with email and password"
      ]
    }
    ```
    """
    try:
        import re
        from datetime import datetime as dt
        
        # Get Anthropic API key from environment
        config = load_env_config()
        anthropic_api_key = config.get('anthropic_api_key')
        
        if not anthropic_api_key:
            raise HTTPException(
                status_code=status.HTTP_500_INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR,
                detail="ANTHROPIC_API_KEY not configured on server"
            )
        
        # Build project directory path
        project_dir = API_WORKSPACE_DIR / request.company / request.project
        
        # Verify product files exist
        product_dir = project_dir / "agent-os" / "product"
        required_files = ["mission.md", "roadmap.md", "tech-stack.md"]
        missing_files = []
        
        for file_name in required_files:
            file_path = product_dir / file_name
            if not file_path.exists():
                missing_files.append(str(file_path))
        
        if missing_files:
            error_msg = f"Required product planning files are missing: {', '.join(missing_files)}. Please run /plan-product command first to create these files."
            raise FileNotFoundError(error_msg)
        
        # Create CLI executor
        from .claude_cli_executor import ClaudeCLIExecutor
        cli_executor = ClaudeCLIExecutor(
            project_dir=str(project_dir),
            anthropic_api_key=anthropic_api_key
        )
        
        # Process each spec intent
        start_time = dt.now()
        results = []
        
        for spec_intent in request.spec_intents:
            intent_start = dt.now()
            
            try:
                # Execute shape-spec with the spec intent
                # Agent-OS will decide the spec name based on the intent
                system_prompt = f"""You are shaping a specification from this spec intent:

{spec_intent}

Follow the /shape-spec workflow to:
1. Analyze the intent and decide an appropriate spec name
2. Initialize the spec folder structure
3. Research requirements by reviewing the product context files
4. Save complete requirements to planning/requirements.md

Do not ask the user questions - make reasonable assumptions based on best practices and the product context files (mission.md, roadmap.md, tech-stack.md).
"""
                
                # Execute shape-spec command
                loop = asyncio.get_event_loop()
                exec_result = await loop.run_in_executor(
                    executor_pool,
                    cli_executor.execute,
                    "/shape-spec",
                    system_prompt
                )
                
                intent_end = dt.now()
                execution_time = (intent_end - intent_start).total_seconds()
                
                # Log the command output for debugging
                import logging
                logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
                logger.info(f"Shape-spec stdout: {exec_result.get('stdout', '')[:1000]}")
                
                # Parse the result to find the spec name created by Agent-OS
                # Look for the created spec directory
                specs_dir = project_dir / "agent-os" / "specs"
                spec_name = None
                spec_path = None
                
                logger.info(f"Looking for specs in: {specs_dir}")
                logger.info(f"Specs dir exists: {specs_dir.exists()}")
                
                if exec_result["success"]:
                    # Find the most recently created spec directory
                    if specs_dir.exists():
                        spec_dirs = list(specs_dir.iterdir())
                        logger.info(f"Found {len(spec_dirs)} directories in specs folder")
                        if spec_dirs:
                            spec_dirs_sorted = sorted(spec_dirs, key=lambda p: p.stat().st_mtime, reverse=True)
                            spec_path = spec_dirs_sorted[0]
                            spec_name = spec_path.name
                            logger.info(f"Selected spec: {spec_name}")
                    else:
                        logger.warning(f"Specs directory does not exist: {specs_dir}")
                
                # Build result
                if spec_name and spec_path:
                    result = ShapeSpecResult(
                        spec_name=spec_name,
                        spec_intent=spec_intent[:200] + "..." if len(spec_intent) > 200 else spec_intent,  # Truncate for response
                        status="success",
                        spec_path=str(spec_path).replace("\\", "/"),
                        requirements_path=str(spec_path / "planning" / "requirements.md").replace("\\", "/") if (spec_path / "planning" / "requirements.md").exists() else None,
                        initialization_path=str(spec_path / "planning" / "initialization.md").replace("\\", "/") if (spec_path / "planning" / "initialization.md").exists() else None,
                        execution_time_seconds=execution_time,
                        error_message=None
                    )
                else:
                    result = ShapeSpecResult(
                        spec_name="",
                        spec_intent=spec_intent[:200] + "..." if len(spec_intent) > 200 else spec_intent,
                        status="failure",
                        spec_path="",
                        requirements_path=None,
                        initialization_path=None,
                        execution_time_seconds=execution_time,
                        error_message="Failed to create spec directory or determine spec name"
                    )
                results.append(result)
                
            except Exception as e:
                intent_end = dt.now()
                execution_time = (intent_end - intent_start).total_seconds()
                
                # Create error result
                result = ShapeSpecResult(
                    spec_name="",
                    spec_intent=spec_intent[:200] + "..." if len(spec_intent) > 200 else spec_intent,
                    status="failure",
                    spec_path="",
                    execution_time_seconds=execution_time,
                    error_message=str(e)
                )
                results.append(result)
        
        end_time = dt.now()
        total_time = (end_time - start_time).total_seconds()
        
        # Determine overall success
        success = all(r.status == "success" for r in results)
        
        return ShapeSpecResponse(
            success=success,
            results=results,
            total_execution_time_seconds=total_time,
            timestamp=dt.now().isoformat()
        )
        
    except FileNotFoundError as e:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST,
            detail=str(e)
        )
    except HTTPException:
        raise
    except Exception as e:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_500_INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR,
            detail=f"Failed to create shape-specs: {str(e)}"
        )

def _run_job_in_background(job_id: str):
    """
    Execute a queued job in-process (no separate worker needed).
    Reads the job from storage, runs the appropriate task function,
    and updates the job status on completion or failure.
    """
    from .job_queue.tasks import run_orchestration
    storage = job_queue.storage

    job = storage.get_job(job_id)
    if not job:
        logger.error(f"Background job runner: job {job_id} not found")
        return

    try:
        if job.type == JobType.ORCHESTRATION:
            run_orchestration(job_id, storage)
        else:
            logger.error(f"Background job runner: unsupported job type {job.type}")
            job.status = JobStatus.FAILED
            job.completed_at = datetime.utcnow()
            job.error = f"Unsupported job type: {job.type}"
            storage.save_job(job)
    except Exception as e:
        logger.error(f"Background job runner: job {job_id} failed: {e}", exc_info=True)
        # tasks.run_orchestration already marks the job as FAILED, but guard just in case
        job = storage.get_job(job_id)
        if job and job.status != JobStatus.FAILED:
            job.status = JobStatus.FAILED
            job.completed_at = datetime.utcnow()
            job.error = str(e)
            storage.save_job(job)
